title: Skill Hub result envelope
description: Stable public result fields are marked public. Optional diagnostics and pagination extensions are experimental; implementation details remain internal.

summary.description: public: Concise user-facing outcome without internal cursor or snapshot terminology.

suggested_actions.description: public: Ordered next actions; L0 responses contain exactly one.

error.description: public: Present for error outcomes; null otherwise.

cli.description: public: CLI-only runnable confirmation command bound to a preview's proposal ID, digest, base version, and workspace.

metrics.description: public: Routing evaluation report, including case counts, rates, per-skill metrics, and failures; emitted by eval routing.

operation_id.description: public: Opaque operation receipt for a completed mutation.

proposal.description: public: Pinned semantic-mutation preview; confirm with every opaque field.

commit.description: public: What happened to the Git commit of an applied hub change; absent when the confirming surface did not ask for a commit (--no-commit).

next_page.description: experimental: Opaque page continuation token; do not display to normal users.

diagnostics.description: internal: Raw technical diagnostics, available only through explicit detail requests.

command.description: public: Application command name, unchanged across delivery adapters.

cli.description: public: CLI-only runnable next command; omitted by MCP.

status.description: public: committed, skipped (not a Git hub, or nothing to commit), failed (the files stay written), or deferred (a chain commits once at its end).

hash.description: public: Full hash of the new commit; present when committed.

message.description: public: Subject line of the commit.

reason.description: public: Plain-words reason a commit was skipped or failed.

manual_command.description: public: Exact Git command that finishes a skipped or failed commit by hand.

this_hub_now.description: public: Agents using this hub read the new version now.

push_needed.description: public: Other clones get it only after a push.

remote.description: public: Name of the remote the commit is published to.

push_command.description: public: Command that publishes the commit to that remote.

agents.description: public: For a change to skills, whether the agents using this hub get them now or what stops them (a draft, an unapproved content, a deprecated or archived skill).

base_version.description: public: Opaque target version pinned by confirmation.
